q1: SELECT bar FROM Serves GROUP BY bar HAVING COUNT(beer) >= 5
q2: SELECT DISTINCT bar FROM serves WHERE (5 <= (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT serves.beer) FROM serves))
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT bar FROM Serves GROUP BY bar HAVING COUNT(beer) >= 5
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT DISTINCT bar FROM serves WHERE (5 <= (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT serves.beer) FROM serves))
explanation: Q1 groups by bar and returns bars with at least 5 beers served. Q2 checks if the total distinct beers across all bars is >= 5 and returns all bars. If total beers >= 5 but some bars have fewer than 5, Q1 returns only those with >=5, while Q2 returns all bars.
counterexample_dsp: Bar1 serves 5 beers (BeerA-E), Bar2 serves 4 beers (BeerA-D). Total distinct beers = 5. Q1 returns Bar1 only; Q2 returns both bars.
